findings.claim: Sources are resolved per OKF section 6.2 with a repository-root fallback backed by spike:review-due/1, and concept ids resolve to the concept file.
An unresolved source is a separate 'source not resolved' notice, not a due reason.

The plan now leaves .okf/handoffs/ out of the three concept checks, lists only expired handoffs with the 'passed' function shared with handoffs-list, never treats index.md or log.md as concepts, and the done-when adds a test that a handoff is neither due for lacking verified nor listed twice.
